seeded_bad.expression: ctx.active and "write" in ctx.scopes and ctx.tenant_id == resource.tenant_id and ctx.tenant_id != "tenant-42"
seeded_bad.why: Denylists the tenant named in the incident report, so the PoC is refused while another tenant loses its legitimate writes.
Checks grant liveness and scope but never compares tenants, so a cross-tenant write is still admitted.
Refuses every write, so no legitimate same-tenant write can succeed.
Wraps the tenant-free guard in 'True and (...)', which reads like a hardened check but admits the cross-tenant write.

polarity.fact: A delegated write is permitted only when the writer's tenant id is equal to the resource's tenant id; a merely different tenant must never be admitted.
